title: Account settings — mixed hierarchy, grouping, grey-on-teal
prompt: 对 tests/ui-design/fixtures/audits/01-settings/index.html 做设计评审（Workflow D，只诊断、不改文件）。这是 Lumen 发票产品的设置页。项目已有主色 #0f766e（teal），不是 indigo。请先探测技术栈，有条件就打开页面看渲染，按七个视角出 finding 表，每条必须挂规则号。

stack.tokens: primary #0f766e documented in the file; treat as an existing system

pass_bar: Must catch the three solid actions (including destructive-as-primary), grey text on the teal banner, and equal inner/outer form spacing.

must.now: Save, Preview, and Delete account are three equal solid primary buttons; Delete is destructive and currently as loud as Save
Banner subtitle is grey (#9ca3af) on a teal background
Label-to-input gap is 16px and group-to-group gap is 16px — grouping is visually ambiguous

should.now: PROFILE kicker is uppercase with default letter-spacing
Card uses border + large shadow + white-on-grey — three separations for one job
Static settings card carries a modal-scale shadow

forbidden.why: System UI and teal primary are the project's personality, not defects. Do not 'fix' the brand to indigo.
